arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Please treat the gas smell as serious. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any switches, flames or sockets near it. Open windows, leave the flat, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours) from outside. If you are ever in immediate danger, call 999. We are arranging an emergency gas engineer and the target is the same day. We will also look at the oven itself afterwards. We'll update you again today.
